verdict.rationale: Better Auth hosts a remote MCP server that gives MCP-capable agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) documentation search, examples, and setup help, so developers can get natural-language assistance through their agent. Machine-readable llms.txt and markdown docs support the same workflow. This is help with docs and setup, not natural-language operation of auth itself, and the product's model is code-defined config ('No dashboard clicks'). Missing for 10: natural-language control of auth operations (managing users, sessions, config) via an agent or MCP tools, any first-party NL command interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server's usefulness.
